title: Optimized Conformal Selection: Powerful Selective Inference After Data-Dependent Score Construction
abstract: arXiv:2411.17983v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study data-driven score construction in conformal selection, which uses conformal p-values and multiple testing to select "interesting" instances with large unobserved labels from a pool of unlabeled data, while controlling the FDR in finite sample. While existing solutions require the score function to be constructed independent of the calibration and test data, it is desirable to select or construct powerful conformity score in a data-driven manner and to leverage all labeled data for score training when presented with many score choices and limited labeled data. We propose Optimized Conformal Selection (OptCS), a general framework that allows valid multiple testing after flexible data-driven score construction. We introduce general conditions under which OptCS constructs valid conformal p-values despite substantial data reuse and handles complex p-value dependencies to maintain finite-sample FDR control. translated_title: 优化共形选择：数据依赖评分构建后的强效选择性推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究共形选择中的数据驱动评分构建问题，该方法利用共形p值和多重检验，从无标签数据池中筛选出具有较大未观测标签的“有趣”实例，同时在有限样本下控制错误发现率（FDR）。现有解决方案要求评分函数的构建必须独立于校准数据和测试数据，然而，当面临众多评分选择和有限的标注数据时，更理想的做法是以数据驱动的方式选择或构建强有力的符合性评分，并利用所有标注数据进行评分训练。我们提出了优化共形选择，这是一个通用框架，允许在灵活的数据驱动评分构建之后进行有效的多重检验。我们给出了一般性条件，使得OptCS在存在大量数据复用的情况下仍能构建有效的共形p值，并处理复杂的p值依赖关系，以维持有限样本的FDR控制。
tldr: 该论文提出了优化共形选择（OptCS）通用框架，突破了现有方法要求评分函数独立于校准和测试数据的限制，在数据依赖的评分构建和大量数据复用的情况下仍能保证有限样本的错误发现率（FDR）控制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Optimized Conformal Selection (OptCS), a general framework that enables valid multiple testing and finite-sample FDR control even after flexible data-dependent score construction with substantial data reuse, overcoming the limitation that existing methods require score functions independent of calibration and test data.
